evidence: app/package.json:4-5 — app rests on @tanstack/react-start ^1.169.4 + @tanstack/react-router ^1.170.46, current stable (Start went 1.0 stable 2026-10-13)
app/src/server/functions.ts:25 — createServerFn used centrally for all data; core Start API, stable but framework was RC until Oct 2026
app/src/server/functions.ts:41 — createServerFn().validator(), the replacement for deprecated inputValidator(), only exists since ~1.168.25 (June 2026)
app/package.json:10-11 — Vite 8 (stable 2026-03) and TypeScript 7.0.2 (native GA 2026-07), both under 8 months old
app/server.mjs:1-2 — srvx 1.0.x with staticMiddleware; srvx hit 1.0 only weeks before today
reach.rationale: Zero experimental/unstable/preview APIs, but the entire app — data layer, build tooling, and production server — sits on frameworks and tools that reached stable within the last ~7 months (TanStack Start two weeks ago). Recently-stable APIs in central places maps to the middle of the scale.

evidence: app/server.mjs — the whole srvx production-server layer is one self-contained file, trivially swappable
app/src/server/functions.ts — all server functions and new-API surface concentrated in a single module; routes consume named functions
app/src/server/pokeapi.ts — API access isolated behind a server-only module, so serialization/validator changes touch one place
app/src/routes/__root.tsx:13 — the one non-public reach-in (m._notFound) is a single line, adjacent to the public status check
containment.rationale: The parts most likely to churn (prod server wiring, server functions, API client) are each isolated in their own module; routes themselves only touch stable, idiomatic Router APIs. The single internal-property use is one line, not spread.

evidence: app/server.mjs:13-19 — srvx + fetch handler is the production-serving pattern TanStack's own examples use; stable 1.0 public API
app/src/server/functions.ts:41,79,100,113 — .validator() is the current documented API; the old inputValidator() is deprecated, so this is required, not novel
app/src/routes/__root.tsx:13 — m._notFound read is gratuitous: the public m.status === 'notFound' on the same line already covers it
app/src/routes/index.tsx:59-66 — filtering, pagination and debouncing done with plain React state + stable router hooks; no experimental primitives reached for
justification.rationale: Every recently-stable API buys something the alternative couldn't (Start server functions keep API fetching server-side per the spec; srvx is the recommended Node prod path; validator() supersedes a deprecated API). The only unjustified reach is the redundant private _notFound check.

findings.issue: head() reads m._notFound, an underscore-prefixed internal match property that is not part of TanStack Router's public API and can change without notice
findings.suggestion: Drop the `|| m._notFound` and rely solely on the documented `m.status === 'notFound'`

findings.issue: @tanstack/react-router ^1.170.46 and @tanstack/react-start ^1.169.4 are on mismatched minors of a monorepo that releases in lockstep, risking type/behavior drift between them
findings.suggestion: Pin both packages to the same minor (e.g. both ^1.170.x)

findings.issue: srvx 1.0 / staticMiddleware reached 1.0 only weeks before this review; the production server depends on very fresh code
findings.suggestion: Acceptable and isolated (single file), but pin an exact srvx version and note the upgrade path to @tanstack/react-start's node-server target

findings.issue: TypeScript 7.0.2 (native compiler, GA 2026-07) and Vite 8 (Rolldown, stable 2026-03) make the whole toolchain under ~8 months old
findings.suggestion: Fine as-is since both are stable releases; keep CI on these pinned versions and watch the Vite 8 / TS 7 patch streams

summary: The app uses no experimental, unstable or preview APIs at all — every import is from the framework's current stable surface, including the freshly GA'd createServerFn().validator() and the srvx production-server path TanStack itself recommends. The risk profile is recency, not instability: TanStack Start reached 1.0 two weeks before this review and the toolchain (Vite 8, TypeScript 7, srvx 1.0) is all under eight months old. The only real blemish is one redundant read of Router's internal _notFound property in the root route.
